record.bible_text: And the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came unto me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,
Son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, What is the vine<WH01612> tree<WH06086> more than any tree<WH06086>, <FI>or than<Fi> a branch<WH02156> which is among the trees<WH06086> of the forest<WH03293>?

Shall wood<WH06086> be taken<WH03947><WTH8714> thereof to do<WH06213><WTH8800> any work<WH04399>? or will <FI>men<Fi> take<WH03947><WTH8799> a pin<WH03489> of it to hang<WH08518><WTH8800> any vessel<WH03627> thereon?

Behold, it is cast<WH05414><WTH8738> into the fire<WH0784> for fuel<WH0402>; the fire<WH0784> devoureth<WH0398><WTH8804> both<WH08147> the ends<WH07098> of it, and the midst<WH08432> of it is burned<WH02787><WTH8737>. Is it meet<WH06743><WTH8799> for <FI> any<Fi> work<WH04399>? <RF>Is it...: Heb. Will it prosper?<Rf>

Behold, when it was whole<WH08549>, it was meet<WH06213><WTH8735> for no work<WH04399>: how much less shall it be meet<WH06213><WTH8738> yet for <FI>any<Fi> work<WH04399>, when the fire<WH0784> hath devoured<WH0398><WTH8804> it, and it is burned<WH02787><WTH8735>? <RF>meet: Heb. made fit<Rf>

Therefore thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; As the vine<WH01612> tree<WH06086> among the trees<WH06086> of the forest<WH03293>, which I have given<WH05414><WTH8804> to the fire<WH0784> for fuel<WH0402>, so will I give<WH05414><WTH8804> the inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> of Jerusalem<WH03389>.

And I will set<WH05414><WTH8804> my face<WH06440> against them; they shall go out<WH03318><WTH8804> from <FI>one<Fi> fire<WH0784>, and <FI>another<Fi> fire<WH0784> shall devour<WH0398><WTH8799> them; and ye shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi>  the LORD<WH03068>, when I set<WH07760><WTH8800> my face<WH06440> against them.

And I will make<WH05414><WTH8804> the land<WH0776> desolate<WH08077>, because they have committed<WH04603><WTH8804> a trespass<WH04604>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>. <RF>committed...: Heb. trespassed a trespass<Rf><CM>
